answer: Operator-Lien Capacity Escrow: each operator registers a non-wallet capacity lien—compute quota plus custody receipts for physical lots (pigment, timber, jade). Wallets draw from that operator’s pool. Shared billing fingerprints or synchronized tx cadence trigger quarantine of the whole pool; the lien is auctioned to reimburse victims and the operator is deplatformed. Attacker cost: all pooled capacity and inventory plus future access, not one wallet.
